subject: Mobile Development
title: China's Super App Culture
description: A short lesson to help you apply China's Super App Culture.

hook.text: In China, one app does everything: messaging, payments, food delivery, and government ID.

buildup.text: WeChat has over a billion users. It's a social network, wallet, and mini-app platform combined.

discovery.text: Mini programs inside WeChat let businesses build apps without the app store.

twist.text: The super app model gives one company enormous control over daily life.

climax.text: Western companies tried to copy super apps but failed. Different cultures, different habits.

punchline.text: One app replaced the entire phone for a billion.

quiz.question: What are mini programs in WeChat?
options: Apps inside WeChat that don't need the app store
